articles.title: Cruise Ship Pianist Rescued After Nine Hours in the Pacific
articles.summary: Two fishermen rescued a cruise ship pianist who had spent about nine hours treading water in the Pacific, helped by unusually warm seas.

articles.title: Ariana Grande Leads a Starry Christmas Carol on TV
articles.summary: Ariana Grande, Robert De Niro and Ben Stiller sang 'O Christmas Tree' on The Tonight Show to celebrate the Rockefeller Center tree's arrival and their new movie.

articles.title: Druski Sings His Way Through His First Night Hosting 'SNL'
articles.summary: Hosting 'SNL' for the first time, comedian Druski stole the show by singing through a proposal gone wrong and a hip-hop throwback sketch.
